applies_to: Belimo 2-way electronic pressure-independent valves (EPIV) version 4.2, DN 15 to 50, BACnet models EP..R2+(K)BAC.
summary: The 2-way EPIV is a characterized control valve with a built-in ultrasonic flow sensor that holds flow regardless of system pressure. Over BACnet it takes a relative setpoint on AO 1 that means either position or flow, and reports position, flow, accumulated volume, flow-body temperature, glycol content and status. The document lists BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP settings.
notes: The document prints access as R / W; those objects are listed here as writable (W).
Flow and volume units follow MV 123 and MV 126; temperature unit follows MV 127.
Sensor 1 objects (AI 20, BI 20) are out of service unless MV 220 selects the matching sensor type.
Data can take up to 190 s to initialise after power-up; values read 0 until then.
Value ranges depend on valve size (DN); see the product datasheet.

integration.summary: Write MV 122 SpSource to Bus, pick position or flow control in MV 100, set the flow limits, then command AO 1 SpRel. Monitor AV 19 flow and AI 1 position, and use the MV 103-106 status objects and AV 140 ErrorState for alarms. If a bus fail action is set, keep rewriting AO 1 or MV 1 within the watchdog time.

minimum_points.name: SpRel
minimum_points.why: Position or flow setpoint from the BMS

minimum_points.name: SpSource
minimum_points.why: Must be Bus for AO 1 to take effect

integration.enable: Write MV 122 SpSource = 2 (Bus); otherwise the valve follows the 0.5-10 V signal on wire 3 and AO 1 is overridden.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 BusWatchdog sets 5-3600 s (default 120 s). If neither AO 1 nor MV 1 is rewritten within that time, the valve moves to the MV 130 BusFailAction (default None; options Open, Close, Max, Min, Stop) and sets bit 15 in AV 140.
setup: MS/TP: baud 9600-115200, default 38400; MAC address 0-127, default 1; max 32 nodes without repeater.
BACnet IP: UDP port configurable, default 47808.
Configure with Belimo Assistant 2; bus termination is set there and shown in BV 99.
gotchas: Writable objects with instance 90 and above are persistent; do not write them cyclically.
Changing MV 100 ControlMode resets the valve.
Vmax below 25% of nominal flow is raised to 25%.
